channel.title: 7News · AI coding
channel.description: AI coding channel: original summaries from official sources

item.title: Codex 0.171: TUI workspace on by default; GPT-6.2 Sol / Astra in the catalog
item.description: Codex rust-v0.171.0 defaults TUI workspace; adds GPT-6.2 Sol (default) and Astra; exec --remote, /rc, configurable undo/redo; toolchain Rust 1.99.1.

item.title: Claude Code 2.1.330 — Enterprise Console sign-in and easel charts
item.description: Anthropic: Claude Code v2.1.330 adds Enterprise Admin Console org sign-in and the built-in easel charting mod, plus fixes for post-compact freezes, WebFetch stalls, and more.

item.title: AWS how-to: use Kimi Code CLI with models on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: AWS how-to wiring Kimi Code CLI to Bedrock model endpoints—auth, model IDs, CLI config, invoke path; not a new model launch.

item.title: Claude Code 2.1.329: stronger /tasks, hook trust prompts, and stability fixes
item.description: Claude Code v2.1.329: hook trust prompts, /tasks with timers and /loop, /mcp remote reject reasons; fixes Keychain logout loops, Code Mode memory, and /code-review—same-day 2.1.328 also ships.

item.title: GitHub Copilot team plugin defaults go generally available
item.description: GitHub Changelog: org teams can set approved Agent Plugins as team defaults for VS Code, the Copilot app, and Copilot CLI; enterprise/org policy still wins; Copilot Business/Enterprise.

item.title: Copilot connectors add Supabase, Box, Calendly, and more
item.description: GitHub’s changelog lets Copilot connect Supabase, Box, Calendly, and more in public preview—Business/Enterprise need the Editor preview policy (and MCP allowlist updates when applicable).

item.title: Gemini 4 Neon lands in GitHub Copilot for Pro+ and up
item.description: GitHub’s 18 Nov 2026 changelog makes Gemini 4 Neon generally available in Copilot for agentic coding and multistep tool use—selectable for Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise on provider list pricing with a gradual rollout.

item.title: Inside the Codex sandbox — OS limits on host commands
item.description: OpenAI explains how the Codex sandbox uses OS facilities to constrain host commands: :workspace writes, broad reads, network off by default, tuned via permission profiles.

item.title: OpenAI Codex 0.170.0 adds TUI realtime voice and MCP/sandbox fixes
item.description: Codex rust-v0.170.0: WebRTC negotiation for TUI realtime voice, refreshable OTLP HTTP auth headers, experimental same-named MCP across environments; plus Windows sandbox, Cloud reconnect, and MCP OAuth race fixes.

item.title: GitHub: maintainers need fixes, not more AI bug reports
item.description: GitHub’s open-source blog argues that in the AI era maintainers need actionable fixes more than floods of auto-generated bug reports.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.327 adds /status diagnostics and MCP/session fixes
item.description: Claude Code v2.1.327: confirm before /install-github-app, mcp add-json from stdin, richer /status for broken configs; fixes project .mcp.json key wipes, Remote Control worktree cleanup, /export overwrite, and resume/hook issues.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.326 pairs Code Mode with Agent Teams, plus wide fixes
item.description: Claude Code v2.1.326 lets you enable Code Mode with Agent Teams on; adds startup/--tools warnings and /status feature-off notes; fixes Bash summaries, background gateway loss, MCP races, login, rewind, and more.

item.title: Huawei Cloud CodeArts earns CAICT 4+ for enterprise coding agents
item.description: Huawei Cloud says CodeArts passed CAICT’s Trusted AI enterprise development agent assessment at the top 4+ grade, spanning requirements through engineeringization.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.325: zstd decode security fix and permission hardening
item.description: Claude Code v2.1.325 fixes a security issue in zstd-compressed response decoding, plus many Bash/sandbox permission, MCP, Code Mode, and gateway compaction stability patches.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.323: experimental Code Mode and plugin engine pins
item.description: Claude Code v2.1.323 adds opt-in Code Mode (JS tool calls), engines["claude-code"] version gates in plugin.json, stronger plugin validate, hook heartbeats, and assorted stability fixes.

item.title: AWS guides enterprise pilots of OpenAI Codex on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: AWS blog: Codex can call Bedrock-hosted OpenAI models; choose Native AWS Access, AgentCore Gateway, or an LLM Gateway, with an open Guidance repo.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is generally available in GitHub Copilot
item.description: GitHub Changelog: Gemini 4 Carbon lands in Copilot’s model picker for Pro+ through Enterprise, billed at provider list pricing under usage-based billing.

item.title: Enterprise GitHub Apps can manage Copilot seats via API
item.description: GitHub Changelog: Enterprise Apps can call enterprise Copilot seat management APIs with the new Enterprise Copilot license management permission.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.322 adds Vertex fast mode in global, us, and eu
item.description: Claude Code v2.1.322 enables fast mode on Vertex in the global, us, and eu regions, falling back to standard speed if Vertex refuses it.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.321: reliability fixes for git, remotes, and subagents
item.description: Anthropic’s Claude Code v2.1.321 improves git/PR reliability, remote reconnect, auto-update retries, and subagent behavior, plus IDE extension install policy changes.

item.title: Copilot impact dashboard adds Chat and VS Code Agents usage
item.description: GitHub Changelog: the Agent adoption chart now includes Copilot Chat and the VS Code Agents window; “Passive users” are renamed Chat-first users.

item.title: Copilot code review gains API settings management and a tighter overview
item.description: GitHub Changelog: manage code review settings via REST/GraphQL from enterprise to repo, with a more compact overview comment plus attribution and reliability fixes.

item.title: Cursor adds realtime voice chat with agents
item.description: Cursor’s changelog enables realtime voice calls with agents in the Agents Window, IDE, web, and iOS—including Siri handoff on iOS.

item.title: Build and share live apps inside Cursor
item.description: Cursor’s changelog lets you build live apps in-product—cloud agents handle build, database, auth, and deploy, then share via a link.

item.title: Foundry Local runs Qwen3.8-27B on-device for Copilot coding
item.description: Microsoft Foundry shows Foundry Local serving Qwen3.8-27B on developer hardware, ONNX Runtime–optimized and wired to GitHub Copilot for private, offline, predictable local coding.

item.title: GitHub Copilot lands in Xcode’s built-in coding assistant (public preview)
item.description: GitHub Changelog: Copilot works inside Xcode’s coding assistant starting with Xcode 27.3 beta; the existing Copilot for Xcode extension remains available.
